title: calonyction album
intro: Calonyction album, commonly known as the "Moonflower," is a species of flowering vine native to Central and South America. The health benefits of Calonyction album include its potential in reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help individuals cope with stress and promote a good night's sleep.
